text_block_list.text:
To encourage Нарита Таисин, I say that if
she
keeps winning, it'll be impossible for
people not
to be impressed by her. But...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, you just ruined the moment.
Thanks a lot.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I cringed so hard when I saw you
grinning like a
fool.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин
choice_data_list: You won! Of course I'm going to be happy!

text_block_list.text: I'm gonna get changed and head back.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
I'm not weak! I'm the fastest of all of
them!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
What's with that creepy smirk? Knock it
off.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Good for you. Doesn't matter to me if
you're
happy or not, though.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: I win these races for myself.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Таисин sounds fed up with me,
but I can
discern a little spring in her
step as she goes off.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As she makes that declaration, I'm struck
once
again by her determination to win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
